title: Shadow Traffic Quality Metrics — Proposed Metrics/Dimensions + Cardinality & Cost (Obs Review Sheet)
content:
Sheet purpose
- Capture the proposed metrics + dimensions for Shadow Traffic (quality deltas) and sanity-check:
  1) expected cardinality impact (Prom/ClickHouse/Logs),
  2) storage/retention cost,
  3) what we will/won’t ship in v1 defaults.
- This sheet reflects outcomes from the Observability review w/ SRE + Telemetry (2026-02-07/08) and the follow-ups after dogfood scoring lag incident.


Assumptions (for back-of-napkin sizing)
| Input | Value | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Control request QPS (per region, typical Dedicated tenant) | 250 | used for examples; scale linearly |
| Shadow sampling rate | 1% (beta default), allowed 0.1%–10% | product will warn >2% for high-volume routes |
| Shadow targets per experiment | 1–2 | v1: max 2 targets; more requires approval |
| Requests mirrored per day (at 250 QPS, 1%) | ~216k | 250*86400*0.01 |
| Avg prompt+context bytes (post-redaction) | 0.5–2 KB | we do NOT store raw prompts by default; refs only |
| Avg completion bytes captured for scoring | 0.5–4 KB | truncated to N chars; configurable |
| % of mirrored requests that get scored | 100% (async) | if backpressure, scoring drops first; see guardrails |
| Aggregate window | 5m + 1h + 1d | console shows 1h by default |
| Artifact retention (request/response refs) | 7d default | Dedicated can set 0–30d; Private configurable |
| Metric retention (aggregates) | 30d (beta) | may align to existing Console retention tiers |


Event types (telemetry payloads) — v1 proposal
NOTE: We are separating “pair” events (routing outcome) from “score” events (async eval results) to keep user-path lean.

| Event name | When emitted | Required? | Approx bytes/event | Notes / cardinality considerations |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| rw.shadow.pair.v1 | on mirrored request completion (control + shadow) | yes | 0.9–1.8 KB | must be emitted even if scoring disabled; contains IDs + timings only |
| rw.shadow.score.v1 | when scoring job completes (per metric bundle) | yes (if scoring on) | 1.2–3.5 KB | include rubric_version, metric set, and compact score fields; no free-form text |
| rw.shadow.pipeline_health.v1 | periodic (30s–60s) | recommended | ~0.3 KB | queue depth, lag seconds, drop rate; low cardinality |


Metric inventory (dashboards + alerts)
Naming convention: rw.shadow.<domain>.<metric>
- domain: routing | latency | errors | scoring | quality
- All rates should be emitted as counters (Prom) and aggregated ratios computed in queries/derived metrics.

A) Routing / coverage metrics
| Metric | Type | Definition | Primary dims (allowed) | Default on? | Alert use |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| rw.shadow.routing.mirror_attempt_total | counter | mirrored attempt created in router | env, region, tenant_tier, route_bucket, request_type, streaming | yes | coverage sanity |
| rw.shadow.routing.mirror_success_total | counter | shadow request sent and completed before shadow timeout | env, region, tenant_tier, route_bucket, shadow_target, request_type | yes | error budget for shadow path |
| rw.shadow.routing.mirror_dropped_total | counter | mirror skipped (circuit breaker/backpressure/quota) | env, region, drop_reason, tenant_tier | yes | page if global/rapid |
| rw.shadow.routing.mirror_timeout_total | counter | shadow target timed out | env, region, shadow_target, tenant_tier | yes | page if elevated |
| rw.shadow.routing.pair_emitted_total | counter | pair event successfully emitted | env, region, tenant_tier | yes | ingestion health |

B) Shadow overhead metrics (guardrails)
| Metric | Type | Definition | Primary dims (allowed) | Default on? | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| rw.shadow.overhead.router_cpu_ms_total | counter | incremental CPU time in router for shadowing | env, region | yes | router team asked to keep as counter not histogram to limit cost |
| rw.shadow.overhead.enqueue_latency_ms | histogram | time to enqueue scoring job | env, region | yes | histogram buckets must match existing job-queue standard |
| rw.shadow.overhead.userpath_added_latency_ms | histogram | measured delta on control path attributable to shadowing | env, region | yes | MUST remain ~0; sampled at 0.1% to reduce volume |

C) Scoring pipeline health
| Metric | Type | Definition | Primary dims (allowed) | Default on? | Alert policy |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| rw.shadow.scoring.jobs_enqueued_total | counter | scoring jobs enqueued | env, region, rubric_version | yes | |
| rw.shadow.scoring.jobs_completed_total | counter | scoring jobs completed | env, region, rubric_version, worker_pool | yes | |
| rw.shadow.scoring.jobs_failed_total | counter | scoring jobs failed terminally | env, region, rubric_version, error_class | yes | ticket unless widespread |
| rw.shadow.scoring.queue_lag_seconds | gauge | max age of oldest pending job | env, region, worker_pool | yes | page when >15m for >10m |
| rw.shadow.scoring.drop_rate | gauge | fraction of jobs dropped (due to backpressure) | env, region, drop_reason | yes | page if sustained |

D) Quality metrics (core product)
Quality metrics are emitted as (a) per-request scores in rw.shadow.score.v1 and (b) aggregated ratios/means via analytics jobs.
Default quality bundle v1 (target):
- format_adherence (heuristic): json_valid, schema_match, tool_call_required_present
- safety/refusal (heuristic + model-graded): refusal_rate, unsafe_content_flag_rate
- instruction_following (model-graded): rubric_score_0_5
- verbosity proxy: completion_tokens / chars (NOTE: often misleading; keep optional)

Proposed aggregated metrics (what Console charts)
| Metric (derived) | Aggregation | Definition | Recommended dims in Console | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| quality.delta.refusal_rate | ratio | shadow_refusals / shadow_scored | region, route_bucket, shadow_target, rubric_version | rate deltas shown w/ Wilson CI |
| quality.delta.format_schema_match_rate | ratio | schema_match_true / scored | route_bucket, request_type, shadow_target | only if structured output enabled |
| quality.delta.instruction_rubric_mean | mean | avg rubric score (0–5) | route_bucket, shadow_target, rubric_version | show effect size + CI |
| quality.delta.unsafe_flag_rate | ratio | unsafe_true / scored | tenant_tier, route_bucket, shadow_target | careful: policy thresholds vary by customer |
| quality.delta.completion_len_p50 | quantile | p50 completion length | route_bucket, shadow_target | keep as secondary; not a “quality” guarantee |


Dimensions catalog (with cardinality expectations)
Legend for expected cardinality per cluster:
- L (low): <100
- M (medium): 100–10k
- H (high): >10k (dangerous) — must be bucketed/hashed/allowlisted or omitted

| Dimension | Description | Type | Expected card | Safe for metrics? | Safe for logs/events? | Proposed control |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| env | prod/stage/dev | enum | L | yes | yes | none |
| region | cloud region | enum | L | yes | yes | none |
| tenant_tier | hosted/dedicated/private + plan tier | enum | L | yes | yes | none |
| tenant_id_hash | stable hash of tenant ID | string | M/H | no (Prom) | yes (events only) | keep out of time-series; only in analytics tables w/ TTL + access control |
| route_bucket | bucketed route identifier | string | M | yes | yes | bucket to <=2k values/cluster; route_id raw not emitted |
| route_id_raw | internal route UUID | string | H | no | no (default) | do not emit; only available to internal debugging via join table (restricted) |
| request_type | chat/completions/embeddings/rerank | enum | L | yes | yes | none |
| streaming | true/false | bool | L | yes | yes | none |
| shadow_target | target variant label (e.g., model@version+quant profile) | string | M | yes | yes | enforce max 2 targets/experiment; normalize labels |
| control_model | control model identifier | string | M | yes (careful) | yes | allowlist to Redwood catalog IDs; no arbitrary strings |
| shadow_model | shadow model identifier | string | M | yes (careful) | yes | same allowlist |
| quant_profile | fp16/int8/int4 etc | enum | L | yes | yes | none |
| rubric_version | scoring rubric semantic version | string | M | yes | yes | required; pin per experiment |
| metric_bundle | which metric set ran | enum | L | yes | yes | keep enum small (<=10) |
| outcome | ok/error/timeout/dropped | enum | L | yes | yes | none |
| error_class | normalized error family | enum | M | yes | yes | map to fixed set; no raw error strings |
| drop_reason | circuit_breaker/quota/queue_backpressure | enum | L | yes | yes | none |
| http_status_bucket | 2xx/4xx/5xx | enum | L | yes | yes | no raw status as label in Prom; use buckets |
| fingerprint_hash | request fingerprint | string | H | no | no | never emit as label; store only as short-lived join key in analytics if needed |
| prompt_id | customer prompt template id | string | H | no | no | do not emit; if needed: customer-side mapping only |
| tool_name | tool/function identifier | string | H | no | limited | if structured tools: bucket to allowlisted names or emit only in sampled debug logs |
| customer_segment | optional customer-defined segment | string | H | no | no | do not accept arbitrary segments v1 |


Cardinality guardrails (decisions captured from review)
1) Hard rule: No raw IDs as Prom labels
- Explicitly banned in metrics labels: route_id_raw, tenant_id, fingerprint_hash, prompt_id, experiment_id.

2) route_bucket design
- Implement route_bucket = stable hash(route_id_raw) mod N with N default 1024 (configurable to 2048 max per cluster).
- Keep a separate mapping table (restricted access) for debugging joins when needed.

3) model identifiers must be normalized
- Use Redwood catalog IDs (e.g., rw/model/llama3.1-70b@2026-01-15) and quant profile as separate dims.
- Reject/strip free-form strings from control plane configs.

4) “Examples” view uses analytics tables, not metrics
- Any high-card filtering (tenant, route, experiment) should happen via the analytics store (ClickHouse/warehouse) with TTL, not Prom.

5) Sampling and emission tiers
- Always-on low-card counters for safety/health.
- High-volume histograms sampled.
- Per-request score payload stored only in analytics (not in metrics) and compacted.


Storage + cost estimates (very rough; for relative comparison)
Notes:
- These are NOT cloud-billing-accurate; they’re for pressure-testing product defaults.
- Assumes compression ratio ~3:1 in analytics store for event payloads.

Scenario table (per region, per 250 QPS control route)
| Sampling | Shadow targets | Pair events/day | Score events/day | Est raw ingest/day | Est compressed/day | 7d artifacts | 30d aggregates |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 0.1% | 1 | 21,600 | 21,600 | ~60–120 MB | ~20–40 MB | ~0.14–0.28 GB | ~0.6–1.2 GB |
| 1% | 1 | 216,000 | 216,000 | ~0.6–1.2 GB | ~0.2–0.4 GB | ~1.4–2.8 GB | ~6–12 GB |
| 1% | 2 | 432,000 | 432,000 | ~1.2–2.4 GB | ~0.4–0.8 GB | ~2.8–5.6 GB | ~12–24 GB |
| 2% | 2 | 864,000 | 864,000 | ~2.4–4.8 GB | ~0.8–1.6 GB | ~5.6–11.2 GB | ~24–48 GB |

Interpretation
- The main driver is scoring payload volume (score events) and any retained example text. Our v1 default should keep example text minimal/truncated, with explicit opt-in for longer retention.
- 1% with 1–2 targets is feasible for beta if we keep dims tight and avoid emitting high-card labels.


Dashboard breakdowns (allowed dimensions)
Approved default breakdowns (Console + dashboards):
- time window
- region
- tenant_tier (hosted/dedicated/private)
- route_bucket (NOT route_id)
- shadow_target
- request_type
- rubric_version

Explicitly disallowed as default breakdowns:
- tenant_id_hash (only via scoped Console views with RBAC)
- experiment_id (only via analytics queries / Console pages; not Prom labels)
- error_message strings
- tool_name (unless allowlisted)


Open questions (tracked as follow-ups)
1) Should rubric_version be required for all scoring jobs? (Obs preference: yes, required; avoids ambiguous comparisons.)
2) Do we want a “customer-provided segment” concept at all? If yes, it must be a bounded enum configured at control plane (not arbitrary strings).
3) Do we need separate buckets for “route family” vs “route”? e.g., /chat/completions vs /embeddings — could reduce N further.
4) Private deployments: where do aggregates live (local ClickHouse vs customer warehouse export)? affects dimension strategy.


Notes from Observability Review (summary)
- SRE (Sean) requested explicit alert coverage for:
  - scoring queue lag (page threshold),
  - mirror_dropped spikes (page if global),
  - shadow target timeout rate (page if >X% and sustained).
- Telemetry (Nadia/Caleb) requested:
  - strict schema validation to prevent customers from injecting label values,
  - single source of truth for allowed label keys per event,
  - documented maximums: route_bucket_count, shadow_targets_per_experiment, metric_bundle_count.
- Applied ML (Selene/Jonas) requested:
  - rubric_version pinned per experiment, displayed prominently in Console,
  - store per-request rubric subscores but keep them compact (ints/booleans),
  - avoid making verbosity proxy a headline metric.
- Routing (Ravi) requested:
  - overhead metrics must prove fail-open (user path not impacted),
  - userpath_added_latency_ms must be sampled to avoid self-inflicted cost.

Changelog
- 2026-02-12: Updated scenario table and removed route_id_raw from any default emission; added route_bucket join-table note.
- 2026-02-09: Added ban list for Prom labels + clarified allowlisted model IDs.
- 2026-01-28: Initial draft from metrics dimension brainstorm (pre-review).
